title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
abstract: arXiv:2611.21885v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models are trained once, frozen and deployed: improving one again takes another training run, and a prompt, a scaffold or extra computation at inference is gone once the task ends. A frontier model has been shown to edit the weights of a much smaller one. We ask whether a model can rewrite its own weights to make itself better, and find that it can, by its own reasoning, with no gradients and no training; we call this self-rewriting. Given its weights, graded answers and the ability to run itself, a 27B model diagnoses its failure and edits the weights behind it. It surpasses itself: its own edit makes it 6.6 points more accurate on 490 problems it never saw, in a test fixed in advance, and another session's edit also makes it significantly better. translated_title: 语言模型能够改写自身的权重
translated_abstract: 语言模型通常只训练一次，然后被冻结并部署：若要再次改进，就需要重新进行一次训练；而在推理阶段使用的提示、脚手架或额外计算，一旦任务结束便会消失。已有研究表明，一个前沿模型能够编辑一个远小于它的模型的权重。我们提出疑问：模型能否改写自己的权重，让自己变得更好？我们发现它可以——仅凭自身的推理，无需梯度、无需训练；我们将此称为“自我改写”。在给定自身权重、有评分的答案以及运行自身的能力的条件下，一个27B模型能够诊断自己的失败，并编辑导致失败的那些权重。它超越了自己：它自己做出的编辑使其在490道从未见过的问题上（测试提前固定）准确率提高了6.6个百分点，而另一个会话所做的编辑也能使其显著变好。它会持续变好：只有当自己的测试支持时它才会提交编辑，每次编辑替换上一次的编辑，在其前八次这样的会话中，其准确率只升不降。
tldr: 该论文提出“自我改写”方法，让27B语言模型仅凭自身推理、无需梯度或训练，诊断失败原因并直接编辑自身权重，在预先固定的490道未见题目上准确率提升6.6分，并在多次自我改写会话中持续提升表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "self-rewriting," showing that a 27B language model can, through its own reasoning without gradients or training, diagnose and edit its own weights, improving accuracy by 6.6 points on 490 unseen problems and continuing to improve across successive sessions.
